items.prompt: After one year, what is the mathematical simple-versus-compound balance gap under the same rate?

options.text: P, because principal belongs to compound balance only.
options.why: Principal belongs in both ending balances.

options.text: 0, because the two one-period balances coincide.
options.why: Both equal P*(1+r/100) after one period.

options.text: P*r/100, because that is annual interest.
options.why: The gap between two equal balances is not the interest amount.

options.text: A guaranteed positive amount for every positive rate.
options.why: Interest-on-interest needs more than one compounding period here.

items.explanation: Both equal P*(1+r/100) after one period.
